description: This file defines an Angular service called GroupService that manages the retrieval and refresh of a list of groups from a server endpoint. It uses RxJS for reactive data handling, including subjects and observable streams, and leverages Angular's dependency injection system.

classes.name: GroupService
classes.description: Angular service that provides methods to fetch and refresh a list of groups from the server.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers the refresh subject to fetch updated group data from the server.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of the current list of groups, sorted and shared for multiple subscribers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers the refreshSubject to reload groups from the server.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns an observable of the grouped list, updating reactively as data is refreshed.
